verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms a live llms.txt at docs.dev.runwayml.com (HTTP 200), and runway.com also serves one. The llms.txt indexes the API concepts, links a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1 spec (also verified by probe), and notes that every doc page is available as raw Markdown by appending .md. Agent-oriented setup docs for Cursor, Claude Code and Codex round this out.
